init.title: Heating, RF monitoring and R8810A diagnostics

data.rf_controller_id: Evohome RF controller ID (01:xxxxxx, leave empty to disable)
data.rf_zone_names: Optional legacy RF room-name JSON (room links can be set from Heating demand)
data.rf_gateway_host: ESP32 gateway LAN hostname or private IPv4 (no http://)
data.rf_gateway_password: ESP32 gateway web password (leave blank to keep existing)

init.description: For the R8810A test page, enter the ESP32 gateway's LAN host/IP and its separate web credentials. This is not your Resideo cloud password. Leave gateway fields empty to disable active diagnostics.

error.invalid_controller_id: Expected a controller device address such as 01:245914.
error.invalid_mqtt_topic: Expected a valid MQTT RX topic ending in /rx.
error.invalid_zone_mapping: Expected a JSON object with RF zone keys 00 to 0B and nonempty room names.
error.invalid_gateway_host: Enter evohome-gateway, evohome-gateway.local or a private LAN IPv4 address such as 192.168.1.50.
